title: Unit tests for isLightningNodeId (src/economy/service-probes.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/economy/lightning-node-id.test.ts` for `isLightningNodeId` in `src/economy/service-probes.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/economy/service-probes.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: a 66-character hex id starting with 02 or 03 is valid (also upper case); a 04 prefix, 64 or 68 characters, non-hex characters, an empty string and undefined are invalid.
